scenario: 面试官问：「你怎么知道这个模型可以上生产了？」
scenario_en: The interviewer asks: 'How would you know this model is ready for production?'
q: 「生产就绪」的标准评估框架是什么？只报一个 held-out 数字或只做 A/B 够吗？
q_en: What's the standard framework for 'production ready'? Is one held-out number or an A/B test alone enough?
why: 生产就绪 = 离线评估（先在历史标注数据上过第一道门）后接在线验证（真实流量上确认），并清楚每一相能测什么、不能测什么。只报一个 held-out 数字或只做 A/B 都不够——面试官期待你不用提示就说全两相。
why_en: Production readiness is offline evaluation followed by online validation, knowing what each phase can and cannot measure; naming only one signals a production-experience gap.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  C["候选模型"] --> O["离线评估\n历史标注数据"]
  O -->|过门的 2-3 个| A["在线验证\n真实流量 A/B"]
  A --> D["上生产决策"]
options: 只要 held-out 测试集上的单一指标（如 AUC）够高，就算生产就绪
离线评估过第一道门、再用在线验证确认，且清楚每一相的能力边界
只做一次 A/B 测试就够，离线指标是多余步骤可以跳过
先小流量灰度上线观察崩溃率，不崩就算就绪，无需离线也无需 A/B
options_en: As long as one metric (e.g. AUC) on the held-out set is high enough, it's production ready.
Offline evaluation passes the first gate, then online validation confirms it, knowing each phase's limits.
One A/B test is enough; offline metrics are a redundant step you can skip.
Just canary a small % and watch crash rate; if it doesn't crash it's ready, no offline or A/B needed.
optionExplanations: 单一 held-out 数字是 proxy，不能保证线上成功，面试官会认为你缺生产经验。
对；两相评估各司其职——离线快而便宜地过滤，在线昂贵但给 ground truth。
跳过离线意味着 200 个候选要做 200 个 A/B，成本和风险都不可接受。
只看崩溃率测的是稳定性不是质量，缺了两相评估的核心。
optionExplanations_en: A single held-out number is a proxy that can't guarantee live success; the interviewer reads it as a production-experience gap.
Correct — the two phases play distinct roles: offline filters fast and cheap, online gives ground truth at a cost.
Skipping offline means 200 candidates would need 200 A/B tests — an unacceptable cost and risk.
Crash rate measures stability not quality, missing the core of two-phase evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 训练时不参与、专门用于离线评估的历史标注数据。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A held-out set is historical labeled data excluded from training, used for offline evaluation.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把用户随机分成对照/实验两组比较指标的在线受控实验。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An A/B test is a controlled online experiment splitting users into control/treatment groups to compare metrics.

scenario: 上任何线上流量之前，先在历史标注数据上衡量模型质量——「拿上季度的剧本走一次带妆彩排」。
scenario_en: Before any live traffic, measure quality on historical labeled data — a 'dress rehearsal on last season's script'.
q: 离线评估作为第一道门，核心优势有哪三个？
q_en: As the first gate, what are offline evaluation's three core strengths?
why: 离线评估：(1) 迭代快——分钟到小时，一下午能比几十个候选；(2) 成本低——零用户暴露、无营收/UX 风险；(3) 可复现——数据集确定 → 结果确定。Airbnb/Uber 常隔夜排队跑实验、次日看看板决定投哪些候选。
why_en: Offline eval is fast (minutes to hours, dozens of candidates in an afternoon), cheap (zero user exposure), and reproducible (deterministic datasets give deterministic results).
options: 实时反映用户行为演化、能捕获反馈闭环、直接测出营收影响
迭代快（分钟-小时）、成本低（零用户暴露）、可复现（确定数据→确定结果）
能提供 ground truth、覆盖真实上下文、天然免疫分布漂移
自动完成 A/B 分流、算好显著性、给出可直接上线的因果结论
options_en: Reflects evolving user behavior in real time, captures feedback loops, and directly measures revenue impact.
Fast (minutes-hours), cheap (zero user exposure), reproducible (deterministic dataset gives deterministic result).
Provides ground truth, covers real context, and is naturally immune to distribution drift.
Auto-runs the A/B split, computes significance, and yields a ship-ready causal conclusion.
optionExplanations: 这些恰恰是离线评估做不到的——它测不了行为演化和反馈闭环，那是在线的活。
对；快、省、可复现正是它能一下午筛掉几十个坏候选的原因。
ground truth 是在线评估的属性，离线只是 proxy，且会受分布漂移影响。
分流与显著性是在线 A/B 的工作，离线不产生因果上线结论。
optionExplanations_en: Those are exactly what offline can't do — it can't measure behavior evolution or feedback loops; that's online's job.
Correct — fast, cheap, reproducible is why it can filter dozens of bad candidates in an afternoon.
Ground truth is an online property; offline is only a proxy and is affected by distribution drift.
Splitting and significance are online A/B work; offline yields no causal ship decision.

termDefinitions.meaning: 上线前在历史标注数据上衡量模型质量的第一道门，快而便宜但只是 proxy。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Offline evaluation measures quality on historical labeled data before launch — a fast, cheap first gate, but only a proxy.

scenario: 一个模型离线 AUC/NDCG/RMSE 都很漂亮，团队想据此直接判定生产成功。
scenario_en: A model has beautiful offline AUC/NDCG/RMSE, and the team wants to declare production success from that alone.
q: 离线评估的根本局限是什么？这些指标能保证线上成功吗？
q_en: What's offline evaluation's fundamental limit, and do these metrics guarantee live success?
why: 静态快照捕捉不到演化中的用户行为、反馈闭环和特征新鲜度问题；AUC/NDCG/RMSE 是 proxy 不是保证——它们能过滤掉明显差的模型，但确认不了生产成功。这道门只负责「排除坏的」，不负责「确认好的」。
why_en: Static snapshots miss evolving behavior, feedback loops, and feature freshness; AUC/NDCG/RMSE are proxies that filter clearly-bad models but can't confirm production success.
options: 没有局限——离线指标高就等于线上成功，可直接跳过在线验证
静态快照捕捉不到行为演化/反馈闭环/特征新鲜度；这些指标是 proxy，只能排坏不能保成功
局限只在算得慢，换更大集群把离线跑快就能当 ground truth 用
局限是离线只能测分类不能测排序，补个 NDCG 就没有任何盲区了
options_en: No limit — high offline metrics equal live success, so online validation can be skipped.
Static snapshots miss behavior evolution/feedback loops/feature freshness; these metrics are proxies that filter bad but can't confirm success.
The only limit is slow compute; a bigger cluster makes offline fast enough to serve as ground truth.
The limit is offline can only test classification not ranking; add NDCG and there's no blind spot left.
optionExplanations: 把 proxy 当保证正是本课要破的误区，离线高不等于线上成功。
对；proxy 只能过滤明显差的模型，确认成功要靠在线 ground truth。
算得快解决不了「静态数据反映不了动态行为」这个本质盲区。
补一个指标补不上「静态快照 vs 动态线上」的结构性差距。
optionExplanations_en: Treating a proxy as a guarantee is exactly the fallacy this lesson breaks; high offline isn't live success.
Correct — proxies only filter clearly-bad models; confirming success needs online ground truth.
Faster compute doesn't fix the intrinsic blind spot that static data can't reflect dynamic behavior.
Adding one metric can't close the structural gap between a static snapshot and dynamic live traffic.

termDefinitions.meaning: 与真实业务目标相关但不等同的可离线计算指标（AUC/NDCG/RMSE），能排坏但不保成功。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A proxy metric correlates with but isn't the true business goal (AUC/NDCG/RMSE); it filters bad models but can't guarantee success.

termDefinitions.meaning: ROC 曲线下面积，衡量分类器在所有阈值上的区分能力。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: AUC (Area Under the ROC Curve) measures a classifier's ranking/discrimination across all thresholds.

termDefinitions.meaning: 带位置折扣的分级相关性排序指标，靠前的相关结果权重更高。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: NDCG (Normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain) is a position-discounted graded-relevance ranking metric.

scenario: 离线评估用的训练特征是批量算好的、可能过时几小时到几天，而线上服务用的是实时特征。
scenario_en: Offline eval uses batch-computed training features (hours-days stale) while serving uses real-time features.
q: 补全离线评估捕捉不到的这个偏差的名字与成因：
q_en: Name and complete the gap offline evaluation cannot detect:
text: 批量算的训练特征比实时服务特征陈旧几小时到几天，这个训练与服务特征不一致的缺口叫 {{training-serving skew}}（训练-服务偏差），离线评估{{捕捉不到}}它。
text_en: Batch training features are hours-to-days staler than real-time serving features; this gap is called {{training-serving skew}}, which offline evaluation {{cannot detect}}.
why: 训练时用的是隔夜批量特征，服务时用的是实时特征，两者取值不同 → 模型线上表现偏离离线。因为离线评估只有那份静态训练特征，它看不到这个偏差，只有上线后才暴露。
why_en: Training uses stale batch features while serving uses fresh ones, so live behavior diverges from offline, and offline eval — having only the static features — can't see it.

termDefinitions.term: training-serving skew / 训练-服务偏差
termDefinitions.meaning: 训练用的批量特征与线上服务用的实时特征取值不一致，导致线上表现偏离离线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Training-serving skew is a mismatch between batch training features and real-time serving features, making live behavior diverge from offline.

scenario: 离线过门后，要在真实流量上确认模型确实改善了业务结果。
scenario_en: After the offline gate, you must confirm on live traffic that the model truly improves business outcomes.
q: 在线评估用哪些手段？它能测到离线测不到的什么？
q_en: What methods does online evaluation use, and what does it capture that offline can't?
why: 在线评估通过受控实验——A/B 测试、interleaving、多臂 bandit——在真实流量上测。它能抓到真实上下文（时段、设备、会话意图、竞争内容、演化中的偏好）和反馈闭环，这是 ground truth。
why_en: Online evaluation runs controlled experiments — A/B tests, interleaving, multi-armed bandits — on live traffic, capturing real context and feedback loops as ground truth.
options: 靠 A/B、interleaving、bandit 在真实流量上测，捕获真实上下文与反馈闭环（ground truth）
靠在更大的历史数据集上重跑离线指标，用样本量换取 ground truth
靠单元测试和集成测试验证代码正确性，等价于在线验证
靠人工标注更多历史样本，把 AUC/NDCG 刷到更高来确认成功
options_en: Uses A/B, interleaving, and bandits on live traffic, capturing real context and feedback loops as ground truth.
Reruns offline metrics on a larger historical dataset, trading sample size for ground truth.
Uses unit and integration tests to verify code correctness, which is equivalent to online validation.
Labels more historical samples and pushes AUC/NDCG higher to confirm success.
optionExplanations: 对；只有真实流量才有真实上下文与反馈闭环，这三种方法都在活流量上做受控实验。
再大的历史集也是静态 proxy，给不了 ground truth。
测试验证的是代码不是业务效果，不是在线评估。
刷离线指标还是离线，不产生任何在线 ground truth。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — only live traffic has real context and feedback loops; all three run controlled experiments on it.
Any larger historical set is still a static proxy and can't provide ground truth.
Tests verify code not business effect, so they aren't online evaluation.
Polishing offline metrics is still offline and produces no online ground truth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 在真实流量上用受控实验（A/B、interleaving、bandit）测业务效果，是 ground truth。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Online evaluation uses controlled experiments on live traffic (A/B, interleaving, bandits) to measure business effect — the ground truth.

termDefinitions.meaning: 把两个排序器的结果混成一张列表给同一用户，按点击归属判优的排序评估法。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Interleaving merges two rankers' results into one list for the same user and attributes clicks to judge which ranker is better.

termDefinitions.meaning: 模型输出影响用户行为、用户行为又变成后续训练数据的循环。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A feedback loop is when model outputs shape user behavior, which then becomes future training data.

scenario: 一个欺诈检测模型离线 AUC 很高，上线后没几天检出率就下滑。
scenario_en: A fraud model has high offline AUC but detection drops within days of launch.
q: 为什么反馈闭环在欺诈/垃圾信息这类对抗性领域最危险？
q_en: Why are feedback loops most dangerous in adversarial domains like fraud/spam?
why: 对抗性领域里有个会主动适应的对手：欺诈者一看到新检测模式就换打法，模型学到的旧模式迅速失效。所以一个离线完美的模型上线后会快速退化——这正是离线评估的静态快照永远看不到的动态。
why_en: Adversarial domains have an adaptive opponent: fraudsters shift tactics once they see the new detection pattern, so an offline-perfect model degrades fast online in ways static snapshots never show.
options: 因为对抗领域的数据天然更干净，离线指标反而虚高、掩盖问题
因为对手会主动适应：一看到新检测模式就换打法，旧模式迅速失效，模型上线后快速退化
因为欺诈样本太少，唯一问题是类别不平衡，与反馈闭环无关
因为对抗领域不能做 A/B，只能靠离线，所以风险高
options_en: Because adversarial data is naturally cleaner, so offline metrics are inflated and hide problems.
Because the opponent adapts: once they see the new detection pattern they change tactics, the old pattern fails, and the model degrades fast after launch.
Because fraud samples are rare, so the only issue is class imbalance, unrelated to feedback loops.
Because adversarial domains can't run A/B, forcing offline-only, hence higher risk.
optionExplanations: 对抗数据不是更干净，问题在于分布会被对手主动改变。
对；有主动适应的对手，是对抗领域反馈闭环最危险的根源。
类别不平衡是另一个问题，这里的关键是对手动态适应导致的漂移。
对抗领域照样能做 A/B，且正因为漂移快才更要在线监控。
optionExplanations_en: Adversarial data isn't cleaner; the issue is the opponent actively changes the distribution.
Correct — an actively adapting opponent is why feedback loops are most dangerous in adversarial domains.
Class imbalance is a separate issue; the key here is drift from the opponent's adaptation.
Adversarial domains can still run A/B, and fast drift is exactly why online monitoring matters more.

termDefinitions.meaning: 存在主动对抗的对手（欺诈、垃圾信息）的场景，数据分布会被对手蓄意改变。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: An adversarial domain (fraud, spam) has an active opponent who deliberately shifts the data distribution.

scenario: 一次超参 sweep 产出 200 个候选模型，在线 A/B 每个要跑数天、还会拿真实营收冒险。
scenario_en: A hyperparameter sweep yields 200 candidate models; each online A/B takes days and risks real revenue.
q: 为什么不能跳过离线、直接给 200 个候选各做一次 A/B？
q_en: Why can't you skip offline and just A/B all 200 candidates?
why: 在线 A/B 慢（数天-数周才显著）、贵（坏变体伤营收/UX）、有风险（真实用户暴露），200 个候选做 200 个 A/B 不可行。离线门先把 200 收窄到 2-3 个认真的竞争者，再上在线——这就是必须两相的根本原因。
why_en: Online A/B is slow, costly, and risky, so 200 A/B tests are infeasible; the offline gate narrows 200 to 2-3 serious contenders before online — that's why both phases are needed.
tradeoff: 离线（快、便宜、可跑数百个 proxy）先筛 vs 在线（慢、贵、给 ground truth）只跑 2-3 个
whenOtherWins: 若候选极少（只有 1-2 个改动）且每个改动都风险可控，可以少依赖离线筛选、更快进入在线；但候选一多，离线门就不可省。
options: 可以跳过：只要并行开 200 个 A/B 桶，几天内就能同时测完，没有问题
在线慢/贵/有风险，200 个 A/B 不可行；离线门先收窄到 2-3 个再上在线
应该反过来：先给 200 个各跑 A/B，再用离线指标复核胜者
跳过离线没关系，因为 A/B 的样本量足够大就不会有假阳性
options_en: You can skip it: just run 200 A/B buckets in parallel and finish in a few days, no problem.
Online is slow/costly/risky, so 200 A/B tests are infeasible; the offline gate narrows to 2-3 before online.
Do the reverse: A/B all 200 first, then re-check the winner with offline metrics.
Skipping offline is fine because a large enough A/B sample removes all false positives.
optionExplanations: 并行 200 个桶会把流量切得过碎、每桶样本不足，且每个坏变体都在真实伤用户。
对；离线负责海选、在线负责决赛，这个漏斗是两相评估的经济学基础。
顺序反了：把 200 个都拿去在线冒险，正是离线门要避免的成本与风险。
样本量再大也挡不住「200 个候选各冒一次营收/UX 风险」这件事本身。
optionExplanations_en: 200 parallel buckets slice traffic too thin for adequate samples, and every bad variant harms real users.
Correct — offline does the mass screening, online the final; this funnel is the economics of two-phase evaluation.
Reversed order: risking all 200 online is exactly what the offline gate exists to prevent.
No sample size fixes the fact that 200 candidates each risk revenue/UX in the first place.

termDefinitions.meaning: 系统性地尝试多组超参数、产出大量候选模型的过程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A sweep systematically tries many hyperparameter settings, producing many candidate models.

scenario: 把离线与在线评估放在速度、成本、数据、现实性、风险、节奏、主要失败模式各维度上比较。
scenario_en: Compare offline vs online evaluation across speed, cost, data, realism, risk, cadence, and primary failure mode.
q: 离线与在线评估在这些维度上分别是什么样？
q_en: How do offline and online evaluation compare across these dimensions?
why: 离线：分钟级、只耗算力、静态历史数据、proxy 信号、零暴露、可跑数百次、主要失败模式是分布漂移。在线：天-周级、影响营收/UX、动态活数据、ground truth、真实暴露、每周几次、主要失败模式是新奇/首因效应。
why_en: Offline is minutes, compute-only, static historical, proxy, zero-exposure, hundreds of runs, failing via distribution shift; online is days-weeks, revenue/UX cost, live dynamic, ground truth, real exposure, a few per week, failing via novelty/primacy.
tradeoff: 离线（快/便宜/proxy/可海选） vs 在线（慢/贵/ground truth/只决赛）
options: 离线给 ground truth、在线只给 proxy；离线慢而在线快
两者数据都是静态历史，区别只在离线免费、在线收费
离线快/便宜/proxy/主要败于分布漂移；在线慢/贵/ground truth/主要败于新奇效应
离线主要失败是新奇效应、在线主要失败是分布漂移，其余维度一致
options_en: Offline gives ground truth and online gives a proxy; offline is slow and online is fast.
Both use static historical data, differing only in offline being free and online paid.
Offline is fast/cheap/proxy, failing via distribution shift; online is slow/costly/ground truth, failing via novelty effects.
Offline mainly fails via novelty effects and online via distribution shift, with other dimensions identical.
optionExplanations: 对调了：离线才是 proxy、在线才是 ground truth；速度也说反了。
在线用的是实时动态数据不是静态历史，这条错。
对；这张对照表是两相评估的核心地图，各维度取向恰好相反。
主要失败模式对调了：离线败于分布漂移、在线败于新奇/首因效应。
optionExplanations_en: Swapped: offline is the proxy, online is ground truth; the speed claim is also backwards.
Online uses live dynamic data not static historical, so this is wrong.
Correct — this table is the core map; each dimension runs in opposite directions.
The failure modes are swapped: offline fails via distribution shift, online via novelty/primacy.

termDefinitions.term: novelty/primacy effect / 新奇/首因效应
termDefinitions.meaning: 用户只因内容是「新的」而短暂多互动，早期在线指标虚高，是在线评估的主要失败模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Novelty/primacy effect is users engaging more just because something is new, inflating early online metrics — a main online failure mode.

termDefinitions.meaning: 评估数据分布与真实线上分布不一致，是离线评估的主要失败模式。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Distribution shift is a mismatch between the eval-data distribution and live traffic — offline's main failure mode.

scenario: 团队发现离线 NDCG@10 提升了 5%，但同款改动的 A/B 显示 CTR 没动。
scenario_en: Offline NDCG@10 rose 5%, but the A/B for the same change shows no CTR movement.
q: 如果离线指标和在线结果不相关，会导致什么？这个案例的最可能根因是？
q_en: What happens if offline metrics don't correlate with online outcomes, and the likely root cause here?
why: 离线-在线不相关会让整个第一道门失效——过门的候选到线上不灵，等于白筛。本例最可能是分布漂移：静态基准缺了 position bias 和会话上下文（用户部分是按位置点击的），所以 NDCG 涨了 CTR 不涨。
why_en: If offline doesn't correlate with online, the whole first gate is useless; here the likely cause is distribution shift — the static benchmark lacks position bias and session context, so NDCG rises without CTR.
options: 无所谓：只要离线涨了就上线，在线不涨说明 A/B 没跑够久
第一道门失效（过门候选线上不灵）；本例根因是分布漂移——基准缺 position bias 与会话上下文
说明 NDCG 是错的指标，应改用 AUC，换指标后自然就相关了
说明模型过拟合，唯一修法是加正则、缩小模型容量
options_en: It doesn't matter: if offline rose, ship it; no online gain just means the A/B didn't run long enough.
The first gate becomes useless (passed candidates fail live); here the cause is distribution shift — the benchmark lacks position bias and session context.
It means NDCG is the wrong metric; switch to AUC and correlation returns.
It means the model overfit, and the only fix is more regularization and less capacity.
optionExplanations: 把不相关当无所谓，等于第一道门白设，正是本课要纠正的。
对；这是课后测验的答案——静态基准漂移、缺位置偏置与会话上下文导致解耦。
换成 AUC 不解决基准缺失 position bias 的结构问题，指标不是根因。
过拟合是另一回事，这里是离线基准与线上分布不一致，不是容量问题。
optionExplanations_en: Treating decorrelation as harmless makes the first gate pointless — exactly the fallacy to correct.
Correct — the quiz answer: a static benchmark that drifts and lacks position bias/session context decouples the metrics.
Switching to AUC doesn't fix a benchmark missing position bias; the metric isn't the root cause.
Overfitting is a different issue; here the offline benchmark mismatches the live distribution, not capacity.

termDefinitions.meaning: 用户部分是因为结果排在靠前位置而点击，而非因为更相关，静态基准常缺此。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Position bias is users clicking partly because a result is ranked high, not because it's more relevant — often absent from static benchmarks.

termDefinitions.meaning: 点击率，衡量结果被点击的比例，是常用在线业务指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: CTR (Click-Through Rate) is the fraction of impressions clicked, a common online business metric.

scenario: 你要排查为什么离线提升没有转化成在线提升。
scenario_en: You're diagnosing why offline gains don't translate to online gains.
q: 离线-在线指标解耦（decorrelation）的常见根因有哪些？(多选)
q_en: What are common root causes of offline-online metric decorrelation? (multiple)
why: 三大根因：(1) 分布漂移/数据 drift——1 月留出集代表不了 7 月流量；(2) 特征新鲜度缺口——批量特征陈旧造成训练-服务偏差，离线看不到；(3) 缺失反馈闭环——离线数据反映的是旧模型的策略，模拟不了新模型下的用户行为。模型参数量多少不是解耦根因。
why_en: Three causes: distribution shift (a Jan held-out set misrepresents July), feature freshness gaps (stale batch features cause training-serving skew offline can't see), and missing feedback loops (offline data reflects the old model's policy).
options: 分布漂移/数据 drift：留出集的时间点代表不了当前线上流量
特征新鲜度缺口：批量特征陈旧造成训练-服务偏差，离线检测不到
缺失反馈闭环：离线数据反映旧模型的策略，模拟不了新模型下的行为
模型参数量太大：只要把层数减半，离线在线自然就相关
options_en: Distribution shift / data drift: the held-out set's time point misrepresents current live traffic.
Feature freshness gaps: stale batch features cause training-serving skew that offline can't detect.
Missing feedback loops: offline data reflects the old model's policy and can't simulate behavior under the new model.
Too many model parameters: just halve the layers and offline-online correlation returns.
optionExplanations: 对；时间上的分布漂移让静态基准与当前流量脱节。
对；批量特征陈旧是训练-服务偏差，离线那份静态特征根本暴露不了。
对；离线数据是旧策略生成的，模拟不了新模型改变用户行为后的反馈。
错；参数量与解耦无因果关系，减层不解决分布/新鲜度/反馈的问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — temporal distribution shift decouples a static benchmark from current traffic.
Correct — stale batch features are training-serving skew that the static offline features can't reveal.
Correct — offline data is generated by the old policy and can't simulate feedback once the new model changes behavior.
Wrong — parameter count has no causal link to decorrelation; fewer layers won't fix distribution/freshness/feedback.

termDefinitions.meaning: 线上数据分布随时间偏离训练/评估时的分布，使静态基准失去代表性。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Data drift is the live data distribution moving away from the training/eval distribution over time, making static benchmarks unrepresentative.

termDefinitions.meaning: 特征值反映最新状态的程度；批量特征陈旧会造成训练-服务偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Feature freshness is how up-to-date feature values are; stale batch features cause training-serving skew.

scenario: 你想量化监控离线代理指标到底还灵不灵，作为是否重修离线设置的触发条件。
scenario_en: You want to quantitatively monitor whether the offline proxy still tracks online, as a trigger to rework the offline setup.
q: 怎么量化离线-在线相关性？什么阈值触发「重修离线设置」？
q_en: How do you quantify offline-online correlation, and what threshold triggers reworking the offline setup?
why: 把最近 10-20 个实验的「离线指标 delta」对「在线指标 delta」画散点、算相关系数。这是给定的经验阈值（不是公式推导）：相关系数掉到 0.5 以下，就该回头检查离线设置——基准是否漂了、缺了 position bias 或反馈闭环。它是离线门健康度的下游触发器。
why_en: Scatter-plot offline metric deltas against online deltas over the last 10-20 experiments and compute the correlation; if it drops below ~0.5, revisit the offline setup.
options: 算离线指标的绝对值，超过 0.9 就说明和在线相关
对最近 10-20 个实验画离线Δ-在线Δ散点算相关系数，低于 ~0.5 就重修离线设置
只要单个实验离线在线同向，就永久判定二者相关，无需持续监控
统计 A/B 的 p 值，p<0.05 即代表离线在线强相关
options_en: Compute the absolute value of the offline metric; above 0.9 means it correlates with online.
Scatter offline-delta vs online-delta over the last 10-20 experiments, compute the correlation, and if below ~0.5 rework the offline setup.
If a single experiment moves offline and online the same way, declare them correlated forever, no monitoring needed.
Compute the A/B's p-value; p<0.05 means offline and online are strongly correlated.
optionExplanations: 相关性看的是 delta 的一致性，不是某个指标的绝对值。
对；用一批实验的 delta 相关系数当健康度，0.5 是经验触发阈值不是定律。
相关性会随分布漂移退化，必须持续监控，不能一次定论。
p 值衡量的是单个实验效应显著性，不是离线在线两个 delta 的相关性。
optionExplanations_en: Correlation is about delta agreement, not one metric's absolute value.
Correct — use the delta correlation across a batch of experiments as a health signal; 0.5 is an empirical trigger, not a law.
Correlation degrades with drift and must be monitored continuously, not settled once.
A p-value measures one experiment's effect significance, not the correlation between the two deltas.

termDefinitions.meaning: 衡量两组 delta 同向变化强度的数值（−1~1），越高说明离线越能预测在线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A correlation coefficient (−1 to 1) measures how strongly two sets of deltas move together; higher means offline predicts online better.

q: 把「健康评估循环」的六步排成正确顺序：
q_en: Order the six steps of the healthy evaluation cycle:
steps: 定义与业务 KPI 挂钩的在线成功指标（营收/会话、留存、欺诈损失率）
选定假设与之相关的离线代理指标（排序用 NDCG、分类用 AUC）
离线迭代：过滤候选、丢掉代理指标回退的
推到在线：把前 2-3 名放到一小部分真实流量做 A/B
分析转化：离线收益是否变成了在线收益、变了多少
若相关性断裂就重校准：查漂移/反馈闭环/特征新鲜度，更新离线设置
why: 先定在线成功指标（终点），再选与之相关的离线 proxy，离线迭代筛选，推 2-3 个到在线，分析离线收益是否转化，最后在相关性断裂时重校准离线设置。多数人只描述第 3-4 步；说全整环、尤其第 6 步，才体现生产成熟度。
why_en: Define online success first, pick correlated offline proxies, iterate offline, promote 2-3 online, analyze translation, then recalibrate when correlation breaks; articulating the full loop (especially step 6) signals production maturity.
diagram:
flowchart LR
  S1["1.定在线成功指标"] --> S2["2.选离线 proxy"]
  S2 --> S3["3.离线迭代筛选"]
  S3 --> S4["4.推 2-3 个上在线"]
  S4 --> S5["5.分析离线→在线转化"]
  S5 --> S6["6.断裂则重校准"]
  S6 -.-> S2

termDefinitions.meaning: 关键绩效指标，衡量业务成功的核心数字（营收/会话、留存等）。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A KPI (Key Performance Indicator) is a core number measuring business success (revenue/session, retention, etc.).

termDefinitions.meaning: 当离线-在线相关性断裂时，排查根因并更新离线评估设置，使其重新预测在线。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Recalibrating means diagnosing the cause when correlation breaks and updating the offline setup so it predicts online again.

scenario: 候选面试者描述评估流程时，通常只说「离线筛选 → 上线 A/B」（第 3-4 步）。
scenario_en: Candidates usually describe only 'filter offline → run A/B online' (steps 3-4).
q: 要体现「生产成熟度」，最该补上评估循环里的哪一步？
q_en: To signal production maturity, which evaluation-cycle step should you add most?
why: 最该补第 6 步——相关性断裂时的重校准：主动监控离线-在线相关性，一旦掉链子就去查分布漂移、反馈闭环、特征新鲜度并更新离线设置，把评估系统当成一个需要持续维护的产品。Google/Meta/Netflix 每季度复查一次。
why_en: Add step 6 — recalibration when correlation breaks: monitor offline-online correlation and, when it degrades, investigate drift/feedback/freshness and update the offline setup, treating evaluation as a maintained product.
tradeoff: 把评估当一次性流程（只筛选+A/B） vs 当持续维护的产品（含相关性监控与重校准）
whenOtherWins: 若这是一个短命的一次性实验（一锤子买卖、之后不再迭代），确实可以省掉常态化的相关性监控与重校准。
options: 补「买更大的 GPU 集群」，让离线跑得更快
补「重校准」：监控离线-在线相关性、断裂时查根因并更新离线设置
补「多加几个离线指标」，指标越多结论越可信
补「延长每个 A/B 到 3 个月」，跑够久就不会失败
options_en: Add 'buy a bigger GPU cluster' to make offline run faster.
Add 'recalibration': monitor offline-online correlation and, on break, find the cause and update the offline setup.
Add 'more offline metrics' — the more metrics, the more trustworthy the conclusion.
Add 'extend every A/B to 3 months' — run long enough and it won't fail.
optionExplanations: 算得快不解决相关性会退化这个核心问题，不是成熟度短板。
对；持续把评估系统当产品维护、断裂即重校准，正是多数人漏掉的成熟度标志。
堆指标不等于会监控相关性，指标多而不校准照样解耦。
无脑拉长 A/B 既贵又不解决离线门失灵，跑久也救不了坏的离线设置。
optionExplanations_en: Faster compute doesn't address correlation degrading — that's not the maturity gap.
Correct — maintaining evaluation as a product and recalibrating on break is the maturity signal most people miss.
Piling metrics isn't monitoring correlation; many metrics without recalibration still decouple.
Blindly lengthening A/B is costly and doesn't fix a broken offline gate.

termDefinitions.term: evaluation as a product / 把评估当产品
termDefinitions.meaning: 把离线-在线评估体系当作需要持续监控、维护、迭代的系统，而非一次性流程。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Treating evaluation as a product means continuously monitoring, maintaining, and iterating the offline-online system, not a one-off.

scenario: 一个新排序模型离线明显更好，团队想立刻把 100% 流量切过去，跳过受控实验。
scenario_en: A new ranker looks clearly better offline, and the team wants to flip 100% of traffic to it immediately, skipping controlled experiments.
q: 在线评估的三大代价是什么？为什么不能拿离线优势直接全量切？
q_en: What are online evaluation's three costs, and why not full-rollout on offline gains alone?
why: 在线评估慢（数天-数周才到显著）、贵（坏变体真金白银伤营收/UX）、有风险（真实用户被暴露）。离线只是 proxy，可能根本没转化甚至反向，全量切等于把这三种代价乘以全部流量、还没有对照组去归因。
why_en: Online is slow (days-weeks to significance), costly (a bad variant hurts revenue/UX), and risky (real users exposed); offline is only a proxy, so a full rollout multiplies all three costs across all traffic with no control group.
options: 慢、贵、有风险；离线只是 proxy 可能不转化，全量切放大代价且无对照可归因
在线没有代价，唯一顾虑是算力，全量切最省事所以推荐
代价只有一个——延迟上升，其余都可忽略，可以直接全量
在线代价是模型太大装不下，只要量化压缩就能安全全量切
options_en: Slow, costly, risky; offline is a proxy that may not translate, so full rollout multiplies costs with no control to attribute.
Online has no cost — the only concern is compute — so a full flip is simplest and recommended.
The only cost is higher latency; everything else is negligible, so go full immediately.
The online cost is the model being too big to fit; just quantize it and full rollout is safe.
optionExplanations: 对；慢/贵/有风险三合一，且离线优势未必转化，所以要小流量受控验证。
把在线说成无代价正是本课批判的误区，坏变体会真伤营收与用户。
延迟只是众多代价之一，忽略营收/UX/风险会踩大坑。
模型大小与「该不该全量切」无关，混淆了问题。
optionExplanations_en: Correct — slow/costly/risky together, and offline gains may not translate, so validate on a small controlled slice.
Calling online costless is exactly the fallacy this lesson attacks; a bad variant really hurts revenue and users.
Latency is just one of several costs; ignoring revenue/UX/risk courts disaster.
Model size is unrelated to whether to full-rollout — a category confusion.

termDefinitions.meaning: A/B 中不接受新变体的那组用户，用于把效果归因到改动本身。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The control group is the users not exposed to the new variant, letting you attribute effects to the change itself.

scenario: 同一个改动，在离线评估里翻车和在在线评估里翻车，最典型的原因不一样。
scenario_en: The same change fails in offline vs online evaluation for characteristically different reasons.
q: 离线与在线评估各自的「主要失败模式」是什么？
q_en: What is the primary failure mode of offline vs online evaluation, respectively?
why: 离线的主要失败模式是分布漂移——静态历史集代表不了当前线上分布。在线的主要失败模式是新奇/首因效应——用户只因内容新而短暂多互动，早期指标虚高，几周后回落。知道各自的典型坑，才知道该防什么。
why_en: Offline's primary failure is distribution shift (static history misrepresents live traffic); online's is novelty/primacy (users engage more just because it's new, inflating early metrics that decay).
tradeoff: 离线防分布漂移 vs 在线防新奇/首因效应
options: 离线主要败于新奇效应，在线主要败于分布漂移
两者主要失败模式相同，都是过拟合
离线主要败于分布漂移，在线主要败于新奇/首因效应
离线主要败于服务器过载，在线主要败于标注错误
options_en: Offline mainly fails via novelty effects, online via distribution shift.
Both share the same primary failure mode: overfitting.
Offline mainly fails via distribution shift, online via novelty/primacy effects.
Offline mainly fails via server overload, online via labeling errors.
optionExplanations: 对调了：分布漂移是离线的坑，新奇效应是在线的坑。
过拟合是训练层面的问题，不是这两相各自的主要失败模式。
对；离线怕静态数据漂移、在线怕新奇效应虚高，这是对照表里的关键一行。
服务器过载和标注错误都不是这两相的典型主要失败模式。
optionExplanations_en: Swapped: distribution shift is offline's pitfall, novelty is online's.
Overfitting is a training-level issue, not the primary failure mode of either phase.
Correct — offline fears static-data drift, online fears novelty inflation; a key row of the comparison table.
Server overload and labeling errors aren't the characteristic primary failures of these phases.

termDefinitions.meaning: 老用户对界面/结果的既有习惯让新变体早期表现被压或被抬，与新奇效应并列的时间性偏差。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: The primacy effect is existing user habits distorting a new variant's early performance — a temporal bias alongside novelty.

scenario: 总结两相评估各自的定位，方便面试里一口气说全。
scenario_en: Summarize each phase's role so you can state both in one breath in an interview.
q: 补全两相评估的定位口诀：
q_en: Complete the two-phase evaluation summary:
text: 离线评估是{{第一道门}}：用历史标注数据快而便宜地{{过滤}}掉明显差的候选，但只是 proxy；在线评估是 {{ground truth}}：用真实流量确认离线收益是否转化成业务提升。
text_en: Offline evaluation is the {{first gate}}: it {{filters}} clearly-bad candidates fast and cheap on historical labeled data but is only a proxy; online evaluation is {{ground truth}}: it confirms on live traffic whether offline gains translate into business lift.
why: 记住分工：离线负责海选、排除坏的、给不了成功保证；在线负责决赛、确认好的、代价高但是真信号。面试里两相都要不提示地说出来。
why_en: Offline screens and rules out the bad without guaranteeing success; online confirms the good at a cost — name both unprompted in interviews.

termDefinitions.meaning: 最接近真实业务效果的信号，这里指在线真实流量上测得的结果。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Ground truth is the signal closest to real business effect — here, results measured on live online traffic.

scenario: 离线阶段要为一个搜索排序模型挑一个「假设与在线 CTR 相关」的代理指标。
scenario_en: In the offline phase you must pick a proxy metric hypothesized to correlate with online CTR for a search ranker.
q: healthy 循环第 2 步——选离线代理指标——该基于什么来选？
q_en: In step 2 of the healthy cycle — picking an offline proxy — what should the choice be based on?
why: 第 2 步的原则是「选一个你假设与在线成功指标相关的离线代理」：排序任务选 NDCG、分类任务选 AUC。关键是这个 proxy 必须和第 1 步定的在线 KPI 有相关性假设，否则离线门筛出来的东西线上不灵。
why_en: Step 2 picks an offline proxy you hypothesize correlates with the online success metric — NDCG for ranking, AUC for classification — so the offline gate actually predicts the online KPI.
tradeoff: 选与在线 KPI 相关的 proxy（离线门有效） vs 选好算但不相关的指标（离线门失灵）
whenOtherWins: 若某任务已有能自动判定的客观正确性（如检索能否命中已知答案），可直接用该客观指标当 proxy，不必套 NDCG/AUC。
options: 选团队最熟、最好算的指标，相关性无所谓，反正在线会兜底
选一个假设与在线成功指标相关的 proxy（排序 NDCG、分类 AUC）
选离线上分数绝对值最高的那个指标，分越高越可信
同时上全部离线指标不做取舍，让在线 A/B 来挑哪个 proxy 对
options_en: Pick the metric the team knows best and computes fastest; correlation doesn't matter since online backstops it.
Pick a proxy hypothesized to correlate with the online success metric (NDCG for ranking, AUC for classification).
Pick whichever metric gives the highest absolute offline score — higher is more trustworthy.
Ship all offline metrics with no choice and let the online A/B decide which proxy was right.
optionExplanations: 好算但不相关的 proxy 会让离线门筛出线上不灵的候选，正是要避免的。
对；proxy 的价值全在于它与在线 KPI 的相关性假设，任务类型决定选哪个。
绝对分高不代表与在线相关，唯分数论会挑错代理。
全上不取舍是回避问题，且用在线来选 proxy 违背了离线先筛的初衷。
optionExplanations_en: A fast-but-uncorrelated proxy makes the gate pass candidates that fail live — exactly what to avoid.
Correct — a proxy's value is its hypothesized correlation with the online KPI, and task type dictates the choice.
A high absolute score doesn't imply online correlation; chasing the score picks the wrong proxy.
Shipping all with no choice dodges the problem, and using online to pick the proxy defeats offline-first screening.

termDefinitions.meaning: success metric 是最终业务目标（在线 KPI）；proxy 是离线可算、假设与之相关的替身。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A success metric is the final business goal (online KPI); a proxy is an offline-computable stand-in hypothesized to correlate with it.

scenario: 有人以为两相评估只适用于推荐系统。
scenario_en: Someone assumes two-phase evaluation only applies to recommender systems.
q: 两相评估思路适用于哪些领域？各领域的差异体现在哪里？
q_en: Which domains does two-phase evaluation apply to, and where do domains differ?
why: 推荐、广告排序、欺诈、搜索、生成式 AI 都适用同一套「离线后接在线」框架；不同的是各域的指标与护栏——欺诈用 AUC-PR、搜索用 NDCG、生成式用人评。框架通用，度量因域而异。
why_en: It applies across recommendations, ad ranking, fraud, search, and generative AI with the same offline-then-online frame; only the metrics and guardrails differ by domain.
options: 只适用于推荐系统，其他领域各有一套完全不同的评估哲学
适用于推荐/广告/欺诈/搜索/生成式 AI；框架通用，指标与护栏因域而异
只适用于分类任务，排序与生成任务无法两相评估
只适用于离线可完全复现的领域，生成式 AI 因随机性被排除在外
options_en: Only for recommenders; other domains each have a completely different evaluation philosophy.
Applies to recs/ads/fraud/search/generative AI; the frame is universal while metrics and guardrails differ by domain.
Only for classification; ranking and generation tasks can't be evaluated in two phases.
Only for domains fully reproducible offline; generative AI is excluded due to randomness.
optionExplanations: 两相框架远不止推荐，广告/欺诈/搜索/生成都通用。
对；离线后接在线是跨域通用的思路，只是度量与护栏随领域调整。
排序和生成同样两相评估，只是离线指标换成 NDCG、人评等。
生成式 AI 恰恰更依赖两相（离线自动指标是弱 proxy、靠在线/人评校准），不被排除。
optionExplanations_en: The two-phase frame is far broader than recs — ads/fraud/search/generation all share it.
Correct — offline-then-online is cross-domain; only metrics and guardrails adjust per domain.
Ranking and generation are also two-phase, just with NDCG, human eval, etc. as offline metrics.
Generative AI depends on two-phase more (automated offline metrics are weak proxies), so it isn't excluded.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不能被牺牲的安全约束指标（延迟、崩溃率等），因域而异。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: A guardrail metric is a safety constraint that must not degrade (latency, crash rate), varying by domain.

scenario: Google/Meta/Netflix 每季度复查一次离线-在线相关性。
q: 「每季度复查离线-在线相关性」这个做法反映了什么工程理念？跳过它会怎样？
q_en: What engineering mindset does 'quarterly correlation review' reflect, and what happens if you skip it?
why: 它把评估系统当成一个需要持续维护的产品，而不是一次性搭好就不管。跳过定期复查，离线门会在分布漂移、反馈闭环变化下悄悄失效——你还在按一个早已不预测在线的离线指标做决策，越努力越偏。
why_en: It treats the evaluation system as a maintained product, not a one-off; skip the review and the offline gate silently decouples under drift, so you keep optimizing a metric that no longer predicts online.
options: 反映过度谨慎，纯属浪费；离线门一次搭好就永久有效，可以不复查
把评估系统当持续维护的产品；跳过则离线门在漂移下悄悄失效、决策越走越偏
只是合规要求的走过场，对模型质量没有任何实际影响
说明这些公司离线做得差，才需要反复补救，成熟团队不需要
options_en: It reflects over-caution and waste; the offline gate, once built, is valid forever and needn't be revisited.
It treats evaluation as a maintained product; skip it and the offline gate silently decouples under drift, steering decisions astray.
It's just a compliance formality with no real impact on model quality.
It shows these companies do offline poorly and must keep patching; mature teams don't need it.
optionExplanations: 离线门会随分布漂移失效，「一次搭好永久有效」正是危险的错觉。
对；定期复查相关性、把评估当产品维护，是生产成熟度的体现。
它直接决定离线门还灵不灵，远不是走过场。
恰恰相反，正因为成熟才知道相关性会退化、需要定期校准。
optionExplanations_en: The offline gate decays under drift; 'built once, valid forever' is exactly the dangerous illusion.
Correct — periodic correlation review and treating evaluation as a product is the mark of production maturity.
It directly governs whether the offline gate still works — far from a formality.
On the contrary, maturity is precisely knowing correlation degrades and needs periodic recalibration.

termDefinitions.term: offline-online correlation / 离线-在线相关性
termDefinitions.meaning: 离线指标变化能否预测在线指标变化的程度，是离线门是否有效的核心健康指标。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Offline-online correlation is how well offline metric changes predict online ones — the core health signal of the offline gate.

scenario: 在线阶段要快速比较两个排序器谁更好，用户级 A/B 因用户间方差太大需要海量样本。
scenario_en: In the online phase you want to quickly compare two rankers, but user-level A/B needs huge samples due to between-user variance.
q: 在线评估里，除了标准 A/B，还有哪些手段？想「省样本地比排序器」该偏向哪个？
q_en: Beyond standard A/B, what online methods exist, and which suits sample-efficiently comparing rankers?
why: 在线手段有 A/B、interleaving、多臂 bandit。想省样本地比两个排序器，偏向 interleaving：同一用户同时看到两个排序器混合的列表、每个用户当自己的对照，消掉用户间方差，样本效率远高于用户级 A/B。
why_en: Online methods are A/B, interleaving, and bandits; to compare two rankers sample-efficiently, lean on interleaving, where each user is their own control, killing between-user variance.
tradeoff: interleaving（省样本、只测相对偏好、限排序面） vs A/B（测绝对业务指标、样本贵）
whenOtherWins: 若你要的是绝对业务指标（营收/会话、留存）或非排序改动，interleaving 给不了，得回到标准 A/B。
options: 只有 A/B 一种在线手段，省样本只能靠加大流量、别无选择
有 A/B/interleaving/bandit；省样本比排序器偏向 interleaving（每用户当自己对照）
偏向多臂 bandit，因为它能给出排序器之间的绝对营收差
偏向纯离线重跑 NDCG，因为在线比排序器不可行
options_en: A/B is the only online method; saving samples means only raising traffic, no alternative.
A/B, interleaving, and bandits exist; for sample-efficient ranker comparison lean on interleaving (each user is their own control).
Lean on multi-armed bandits, since they give the absolute revenue gap between rankers.
Lean on rerunning NDCG offline, since comparing rankers online is infeasible.
optionExplanations: 在线手段不止 A/B，且盲目加流量成本高、没利用方差削减。
对；interleaving 让每个用户当自己的对照，消除用户间方差，比排序器最省样本。
bandit 给的是 regret/分配优化，不是排序器间干净的绝对营收差。
在线比排序器完全可行（interleaving 就是为此设计），退回离线答非所问。
optionExplanations_en: Online methods aren't just A/B, and blindly raising traffic is costly and ignores variance reduction.
Correct — interleaving makes each user their own control, removing between-user variance, most sample-efficient for ranker comparison.
Bandits give regret/allocation optimization, not a clean absolute revenue gap between rankers.
Comparing rankers online is entirely feasible (interleaving is built for it); retreating offline misses the point.

termDefinitions.meaning: 不同用户行为差异带来的噪声，用户级 A/B 需大样本才能压过它；interleaving 用同一用户消除它。
termDefinitions.meaningEn: Between-user variance is noise from users behaving differently; user-level A/B needs large samples to overcome it, while interleaving removes it via the same user.
